field_edits.updated_text: Bone mineralization is within normal limits. No erosive osseous changes or aggressive bone lesion is identified. No acute fracture or focal osseous lesion.

Mild degenerative osteoarthrosis involving the first carpometacarpal (CMC) joint with mild joint space narrowing and small marginal osteophytes. Minimal scattered degenerative changes are present in the interphalangeal joints. The remaining joint spaces are preserved. No dislocation.
Mild soft tissue swelling is present about the hand. No radiopaque foreign body is seen.

impression:
1. Mild degenerative osteoarthrosis of the first carpometacarpal (CMC) joint with mild joint space narrowing and small marginal osteophytes.
2. Minimal scattered degenerative changes in the interphalangeal joints.
3. Mild soft tissue swelling of the hand.
4. No acute fracture or dislocation.
